reasoning: Choose the 3 fixed points: C(10,3) = 120 ways. The remaining 7 points must carry a permutation with no fixed points and no 2-cycles, i.e., all cycles have length ≥3. The only cycle-type partitions of 7 with all parts ≥3 are: (7) and (4,3). Count for a 7-cycle: 7!/7 = 720. Count for (4,3): 7!/(4·3) = 5040/12 = 420. So admissible permutations on the 7 remaining points total 720 + 420 = 1140. Final count: 120 × 1140 = 136800.
